localFixes.description: Amortized pruning of expired weak cache metadata, with an implicit weak hold and positive-only weak locking so concurrent final releases cannot invalidate control state. No instance layout changes.
localFixes.provenance: Implemented locally for this package; not attributed to upstream PR 1824.

runtimeRegistries.description: Synchronize five process-wide runtime registries with short native-only locks; invalidate cached JSI values before removing only the owning runtime entries. Publish dispatchers after successful JSI installation and ensure dispatcher-only runtimes have a teardown owner. Registry storage survives process shutdown ordering; no instance layout changes.
runtimeRegistries.provenance: Implemented locally for this package; not attributed to upstream PR 1824.

debugDiagnostics.description: Confine the fixed small diagnostic regex cache to each calling thread, avoiding concurrent cold prototype-initialization races. Release demangling does not use this cache.
debugDiagnostics.provenance: Implemented locally for this package; not attributed to upstream PR 1824.

threadPoolStartup.description: Stop and join partially created workers before constructor unwind; count workers only after successful creation so failed expansion can retry. No public interface or instance layout changes.
threadPoolStartup.provenance: Implemented locally for this package; not attributed to upstream PR 1824.
